title: CGI Federal launches AI Agent Catalog to help federal agencies accelerate mission outcomes
summary: CGI Federal Inc. announced the AI Agent Catalog, a new offering developed in collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help federal agencies rapidly deploy secure, responsible and mission-aligned agentic AI across government environments.
body_markdown:
[CGI Federal Inc.](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal) (CGI Federal), a leading provider of technology and professional services for the U.S. government, today announced the AI Agent Catalog, a new offering developed in collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help federal agencies rapidly deploy secure, responsible and mission-aligned agentic AI across government environments.


Built for scalable enterprise-wide adoption, CGI Federal’s[AI Agent Catalog](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal/ai/agents) provides federal agencies with thousands of curated AI agent use cases designed to address critical mission challenges, including enhanced cyber defenses, fraud detection, benefits processing and back-office modernization, while meeting the security, governance and compliance requirements of U.S. government operations. The offering also provides tooling to generate self-directed agents that safely navigate secure federal environments and automate complex administrative and operational workflows, allowing federal employees to focus on initiatives that require human judgment, collaboration and expertise.


> "Federal leaders are looking for a secure, governed path to deploy agentic AI at scale where it can make a measurable impact on mission delivery," said Karim Fadel, Vice-President, Business Engineering and AI Go-to-Market Strategy, CGI Federal. "With the AI Agent Catalog, federal agencies can move beyond isolated pilots to rapidly deploy mission‑specific agents that automate critical work, strengthen oversight and give teams more time to focus on higher-value work. This offering gives federal teams a foundation to adopt agentic AI responsibly and with confidence, ensuring human judgment stays at the center while accelerating innovation across the enterprise."


CGI Federal’s AI Agent Catalog is augmented by governance advisory services and helps federal agencies turn information into actionable insights that support informed decision-making. These mission-specific agents will enable federal agencies to conduct more thorough auditing, strengthen due diligence and maintain greater visibility into AI activity across the enterprise.


This new offering also builds on CGI Federal’s broader portfolio of governed AI capabilities for the U.S. government, including its[AI-powered IT modernization](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal/ai-it-modernization) offering, enabled by its proprietary digital workforce accelerator,[CGI YukonTM](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal/solutions/yukon) . Combined with CGI Federal’s deep domain expertise across federal agencies, the AI Agent Catalog will help federal agencies apply[agentic AI](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/artificial-intelligence/agentic-ai) effectively and responsibly to their most complex mission challenges.


### About CGI Federal


CGI Federal Inc. is a leading U.S.-based technology and professional services company that serves federal agencies across defense, civilian, healthcare, justice, intelligence and international affairs. With nearly 8,000 professionals, CGI Federal works with its clients to modernize government through innovative technology solutions, flexible delivery models and a commitment to achieve mission outcomes. CGI Federal is a wholly-owned subsidiary of CGI Inc. For more information, visit www.cgifederal.com.
